paragraphs: From Birr, County Arms Hotel, set off along Emmet Street.
Continue to the right onto Glebe Street.
Keep going straight as the road becomes Burke's Hill, watching for parked cars and pedestrians.
Take the next right into Meadow Court.
At the end of Meadow Court, perform a controlled U-turn, checking mirrors and blind spot.
Head back out and turn left to rejoin Burke's Hill.
Take the 1st right into Woodlands Park.
At the end of the road turn right onto the Tullamore Road.
After a short distance, turn right into a small side road.
Complete a U-turn in the side road.
Turn left to continue along the Tullamore Road.
Follow the Tullamore Road for just under a kilometre.
Turn right into McAuley Drive.
Take the next right onto Cappaneale Upper.
Continue through the estate roads, keeping your speed low and watching for children and driveways.
Turn left onto the Banagher Road.
Hold your lane as it becomes Model School Road, then Banagher Road again, and finally Rosse Row.
Look well ahead for traffic filtering in from side streets.
Turn left onto The Green.
Take the next left back onto Emmet Street toward the County Arms Hotel.
Pull in smoothly using the mirror, signal, manoeuvre routine to finish at the test centre.
